2608.21243.title: Adapting Knowledge Graphs for Behavior Denoising in Sequential Recommendation
2608.21243.paper_summary: Sequential recommendation predicts the next item from a user's interaction history, but not every interaction is equally informative. Real logs combine persistent preferences with temporary needs, exploration, and incidental behavior, so some interactions can distort history representations or provide unreliable supervision. Existing denoising methods judge such interactions mainly from co-occurrence, order, or model predictions, without explicit evidence from relations between items. Knowledge graphs (KGs) offer this evidence, but item popularity, graph degree, uneven coverage, and widely shared entities can inflate connectivity and bias reliability estimates. Here we present AdaptedKG, which derives calibrated KG evidence for each training example without adding graph representations to the recommendation model. It first compares the observed context with structurally matched alternatives to identify relational paths that are unusually prominent and uses them to build a local KG view. It then compares each interaction with structurally matched reference items to calibrate its support within that view. The resulting retention coefficients gate historical representations and reweight target losses. All sample-specific scores are computed offline using training interactions and a fixed KG, so the backbone remains unchanged and no KG access is required at inference. Experiments show gains with a standard sequential recommender and multiple behavior-denoising sequential recommenders.
2608.21243.paper_summary_zh: 序列推薦根據用戶的互動歷史預測下一個項目，但並非每次互動都同樣具有信息量。真實的日誌結合了持久的偏好與臨時需求、探索和偶然行為，因此某些互動可能會扭曲歷史表示或提供不可靠的監督。現有的去噪方法主要根據共同出現、順序或模型預測來評價這些互動，而沒有明確的項目之間關係的證據。知識圖譜（KGs）提供了這種證據，但項目受歡迎程度、圖的度數、不均勻的覆蓋範圍和廣泛共享的實體可能會膨脹連通性並偏見可靠性估計。在此，我們提出了AdaptedKG，它為每個訓練示例推導經過校準的KG證據，而不將圖表示添加到推薦模型中。它首先將觀察到的上下文與結構匹配的替代方案進行比較，以識別異常突出的關係路徑，並利用這些路徑建立局部KG視圖。然後，它將每次互動與結構匹配的參考項目進行比較，以校準其在該視圖中的支持。最終的保留系數對歷史表示進行閘控並重新加權目標損失。所有特定樣本的分數都是使用訓練互動和固定KG離線計算的，因此骨幹保持不變，推理時不需要訪問KG。實驗顯示，標準序列推薦器和多個行為去噪序列推薦器均有增益。
